title: Operations Overview – Live Meteorological Globe
prompt:
Restore the prominent interactive 3D meteorological globe and greatly expand the real-time weather animation across the entire background canvas while preserving all operational data.

Key implementation:
1. LARGE PROMINENT 3D METEOROLOGICAL GLOBE (45-55% visual stage):
   - Place a dedicated, high-fidelity interactive 3D canvas viewport (`#interactive-globe-canvas`) centered prominently.
   - Features dark Earth sphere, graticules (lat/lon lines), subtle vector landmasses emphasizing the Indian Subcontinent (65°E–100°E), Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Himalayas.
   - Live weather overlays on the globe: Convective storm cloud vortex over Delhi, cyclonic swirl in Arabian Sea, and dynamic precipitation heat glow.
   - Interactive toolbar on the globe: Rotate drag, Zoom (+/-), Reset View, GPS center, and Layer Switcher (TEMP, PRECIP, WIND, MSLP).
   - Selected location reticle: New Delhi (28.58°N, 77.20°E) with floating telemetry badge (34°C, Thunderstorm, 91% Confidence).

2. EXPANDED LIVE ATMOSPHERIC ANIMATION (70-90% visual stage):
   - Full-bleed ambient weather canvas `#weather-particle-canvas` surrounding the globe and extending across the entire page.
   - Working multi-weather simulation: Thunderstorm with timed lightning branch flashes & ambient flash overlay; Rain streaks with angled velocity; Snow with drifting flakes; Heatwave with shimmer; Fog; Sun with rays; Wind.
   - Controlled via the 13-chip Sky Control strip (Thunderstorm, Rain, Cloudburst, Cyclone, Heatwave, Dust, Fog, Wind, Cloudy, Sunny, Coldwave, Snow, Night), Intensity slider, and MONO switch.

3. FLOATING DATA PANELS (Preserving 100% of existing content):
   - Hero telemetry card: New Delhi Safdarjung 34°C (Feels 36°C), Thunderstorm, CAPE 2850 J/kg, Wind 18 km/h, Rain 72% (62mm/24h), Humidity 64%, MSLP 1003.8 hPa, Blend Confidence 91%.
   - Lead-time scrubber (-48h to +240h in 6h steps) with Play/Pause forecast progression.
   - System Diagnostics (NCUM-G, NEPS-G, BharatFS, GraphCast, AIFS, GenCast, GFS, INSAT-3DR).
   - Active Synoptic Regimes (Monsoon Trough, Cyclonic Circulation, Western Disturbance).
   - Priority Extreme Signal: Arabian Sea Cyclone track preserving 72% AI probability.
   - Saved Stations: Mumbai (29°C), Bengaluru (22°C), Shimla (-02°C), Kochi (28°C).
   - Keep script modular, concise, and clean to avoid truncation.
